title: Can memistor-class electrochemical weights train neural networks? Code, records and pulse draws
description:
Everything needed to reproduce the paper “Can memistor-class electrochemical weights train neural networks?” (version 12): the simulators and their checks, the pulse streams and probes, the pod run scripts, the energy model, the analysis and figure scripts, every run record, the device catalog with per-field provenance, the citation check, the 12 saved pulse-draw archives, the plans, deviations and responses to nine independent reviews together with the reviews, the paper sources and built PDFs/HTML, and the bench protocol. Datasets (MNIST, CIFAR-10, enwik8) are not included; fetch_data.py downloads them and checks the pinned digests.
